description: Updates fields on an existing single calendar event; only the fields supplied are changed, all others keep their current value. Imported (subscription-sourced) events cannot be edited.

endDate.description: All-day only: new LAST day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Alone it keeps the current first day. Dates are stored in the event's own end rule (see list_calendar_events).

endDateTime.description: New end of a timed event, ISO 8601 UTC. Must not precede startDateTime. For all-day events send endDate instead. An all-day endDateTime is stored as given and keeps the event's own end rule (see list_calendar_events): with no source a midnight end names the LAST day, on a device-calendar event the day after it.

id.description: Event id from create_calendar_event or list_calendar_events.

isAllDay.description: True for all-day, false for timed.

location.description: Replaces the location outright. $type 'Address' takes line1-3/postalCode/countryCode; 'OnlineLocation' takes url/notes.

line1.description: Address line 1. An Address needs one of line1-3 or postalCode.

line2.description: Address line 2, e.g. flat or suite.

notes.description: Access detail, e.g. parking or passcode.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: New reminder lead times, in minutes before the event starts. Send the full list: it replaces the current one. [] clears all reminders; omit to keep them. Reminders move with the start. Not allowed on imported events (device calendar or subscription). Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 525600 (365 days); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. An all-day event counts from 00:00 on its first day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before the start, or up to 15 minutes earlier. Every household member is reminded.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

startDate.description: All-day only (preferred for all-day): new first day, YYYY-MM-DD. Without endDate the event becomes a single day.

startDateTime.description: New start of a timed event, ISO 8601 UTC. For an all-day event send startDate instead.

timezone.description: IANA zone for the wall-clock times, e.g. 'Europe/London'. Null means UTC.

name: update_calendar_event
